newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TABLE-Romania unemployment flat at 6.8 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Romania unemployment flat at 6.8 pct in June.

text.p: Romania's unemployment rate was 6.8 percent in June, unchanged from May, the Labour Ministry said on Monday.
The number of jobless people rose by just 4,000, leaving the unemployment rate unchanged from May, it said.

NOTE -- Romania's workforce is 10.491 million. According to government forecasts, Romania is expected to end 1997 with a jobless rate of 10.3 percent, up from 6.1 percent at end-1996, as restructuring of communist-era industries gains ground.
